t: Greetings, my lords. May I ask you what brings you to this Tensess-forsaken hole? The capital has finally sent some real fighters instead of pot-bellied priests?

Until recently, we heard nothing of them. And now vampires are threatening us in the night, and werewolves are prowling around the village in the daylight!

Where did they come from? I have no idea! I thought that maybe someone from the village broke my ban and went to the old ruins in search for treasures, and found... the treasure, damn it! All kinds of nasty things dwell there. That's why we have sealed the portal with a special key.

It's a tragedy! Humans and elves used to live in perfect harmony! I owe all my knowledge to the elven patriarch, Alister. He is beautiful as an ancient statue and is wiser than Aidenus himself!

I cannot imagine what could have possibly happened. What could transform these beautiful creatures into spawns of darkness? Nevertheless, it was for real.

I figured out what happened when I saw the first victim. Immediately, I went to the elven enclave to see Alister... I saw that I was right. All elves had turned into bloodsuckers! And there is no way I can take down their patriarch - I am as weak as a kitten comparing to him.

It is hard to believe that, but once it used to be a thriving trade town. And here it was a tiny village, where peasants raised turnips and cabbages.

Now... it is all that's left. The town was cursed. The dead rose against the living! How? Why? I do not know.

The few ones who survived fled and destroyed the bridge to the town. Now its streets are only filled with ghosts and the undead...

The road to the town was sealed. To unlock the portal, you will need a special key that my former mentor forged. There are only two of them - I used to have one, but then I gave it to the priest, and Alister had the second one. And I'm sure he won't just give it to us...

The Inquisitors? Ha!

When things got pretty tough here, they sent a squad of clerics, led by thick-headed priest, who swung their incense burners and stank out the whole place with mirra. They took the key to the portal and went to the ruins. They said, only a Holy ritual could cleanse the evil that was hiding there!

So, they took a pile of magical reagents from us and stepped through the portal. It was the last time we saw them.

There was a huge explosion! Lightning bolts, and windwirls raised to the skies! I doubt that any one of them survived. Now they must be roaming the town streets as well...
Hmm... Raven feather and magical thread. So what? This werewolf could be anyone while he was still alive! I have nothing to do with that!
h: Show the Werewolf Chief Amulet to the Sorceress

t: What a strange letter! The one who wrote it must have been maddened with pain. To threaten an elven archmage, huh! That peasant woman had lost her mind if she dared to write of her love to Alister and demand that he fulfill some promise. Demand! From a vampire patriarch! It is strange that Alister read this scribbling at all...
h: Show the letter to the Sorceress

t: I wanted to marry well. I am an extraordinary connoisseur of beauty, a person of invincible egoism. Above anything else I value myself, my comfort and peace.
Hello there! How can I help you?
Kania is rightfully mine! Valirs have ruled these lands for generations, and they will reclaim their power! Sister... if you could return from the world of the dead, so can I!

h: Do you have something for me?

t: What is it? Are you here to taunt the prisoners?

Don't torture us. We'll tell you everything we know! We'll even tell you things that we don't know! We were promised freedom soon, but we don't believe a word of it. So please, just stop hurting us.
Who promised that? Why, Ignat of course. He kept talking about freedom and peace, but his plans seemed pretty farfetched. Who's going to launch a big operation just to save the likes of us?
What is it? Are you alright?

Very interesting... I think that sphere in the sarcophagus is the very "Object"! Why didn't Tep take it with him? Or maybe he couldn't reach it?

The funny thing is, you only see your "visions" when you get close to the... "alien energy". I'm not sure what to call it.

The first time it happened under the ice, when you touched the meteorite shard, from which the energy emitting crystal was extracted.

The second one occurred when you were affected by the energy in the Bestiary. And now - when you came close to the Object.

quests: The Curse of the Valir Castle

t: Choose your mount, and remember to add stable slots!
I sense danger... We shouldn't stay here for too long.

Life is frozen here. It's like the nature is dead, but it fails to realize that it's dead.

The orcs are very strong, given that they manage to survive here.

All right. Allow me to perform the Ritual of Truth on them.

It will take a minute.

Child of Chaos, what is a prophecy? Time is unstable and volatile. The future branches out into multiple possible pathways. Once... the Architect tried to change the future by putting other worlds in order. Temporal distortion, calculation of possible scenarios, attempts to affect the outcome. Some things worked, some didn’t. The Architect abandoned these attempts.

Time... is too chaotic.
h: Sculptor, what can you tell me about the prophecy?

t:
[A shadow of recognition passes over the Sculptor's face]

The All-Mother. The Goddess of Creation. The beginning of Order and Chaos.

Yes. I remember. As a result of our meeting, I was separated from the Architect's mind.
h: Tell them what you have managed to learn in Eden

t:
Shades of chaos are innumerable.

It does not matter who wins - the Expedition or the All-Mother.

To defeat the Darkness, you need powers that can be found in your world as well.

Don't worry, Stormbringer. Every creature, mortal or divine, gives a lot of meaning to their own death. But in fact... you understand, don't you?

Umoir gods have every reason to worry about their people. While mortals believe in magic and miracles, the old gods will be replaced with the new ones. Young, naive, beautiful! They will have this world.

Who knows, how many gods there were before on Umoir...
h: Talk about your dream and the Sage.

t:
Frontier has become the last refuge for many civilizations and even races. Its continuum seems to attract the "events of the end".

The Lizardmen patron is a very interesting figure. They settled there just recently. The appearance of a powerful magical anomaly with its own will over such a short period seems unlikely. I will carefully observe them.
h: Ask for an opinion about Frontier.

t:
The ability of its creatures to leave behind intelligent soulprints, that add more chaos to the communication of the living, puzzles me.

Intelligent beings of this world develop fast enough to regulate their own existence.

In my opinion, the spirits' exodus will have a good impact on Enclave civilizations. I wonder what the catalyst for the events is... Orcish spirits are not the only fading magical anomalies. I have seen similar events occuring all over Sarnaut.
h: Ask for an opinion about Gipat.

t:
It's interesting. If creatures with signs of divinity are losing power, it is usually caused by the weakening of the mental energy influx from the inferior associates. In your case, it would be faith.

But I don't see how the faith of Umoir residents is weak! In fact, it's stronger than ever. It means, something else is making gods leave this world.

I know that Order and Chaos must exist together in Harmony. However, this event goes against Harmony. When the gods' power is weakened, faith is weakened. In this case, gods will disappear forever. What happens to the balance of Sarnaut's powers... is unpredictable.
h: Ask for an opinion about Umoir.

t: The world of chaos is amazing.

It wasn't my intention to arrive here.

The Centaurs summoned me. We had certain... difficulty in communication. We might need your help.
h: Ask about the Sculptor's objectives in the Centaur Camp.

t: What huge trees! You can't see the sky behind the canopy. It's an amazing place.

Greetings, my friend!

I was happy to get an invitation. To see you all. There are so many of you. And you are all so different!

Greetings, Stormbringer!

I was happy to get an invitation. To see you all. There are so many of you. And you are all so different!

We centaurs are still trying to find our way in this world. We settled in the Frontier steppes. And some have left to explore other allods. I hope my brethren can find their place and destiny among you.

And if you need our help - you need only ask.
It's so good to see the green valleys of the Spiral Ridge again! This land is not friendly anymore, but I will miss it when we leave for our new home...

Caw! This hasn't happened in a long time! But everything happens for the first time, and the fate of Isa is again connected with the rest of the world! Perhaps, with time, the Children of the Ash Tree and the twice-born Pridens will reclaim their homeland! After all, the world is changing!
h: What are your thoughts on what happened?

t: Caw! The raven has a lot to do now! Fly around Isa, see how the departure of Kharyskhan affected those who leave their footprints in the snow! Then - together with the ships, which now also fly on wings, he will go to other lands, see other fragments of Isa, which the eye has not seen for many centuries...
Caw! The black-feathered one did not believe he would see the hour when the broken Threads would again bind Isa and other lands together...
The underground fire warms like the hot sun in the cold skies.
If you follow the path pointed out by a liar, you will find only lies at the bottom of the misty city! Carr!
We should do something else... My head is buzzing...
These catacombs, ... They are too ancient and mysterious.
It's like nothing has really changed, but I keep having these visions... Something is coming, , I can feel it. This was nothing. Well, we're on vacation, so let's enjoy it...
I'm great! Another adventure is over, the Hero of Sarnaut had the most fun... But I'm used to it. Take your seat!
Much better now! Skulnar is planning something, I hope you'll join us!
It's going to be a nice evening!

I've seen a lot in my life, but this... Eysh!

My tail is twitching and my furrrr stands on end! Perrrhaps, I'm not used to it. Haven't we seen otherrrr worrrrlds, afterrrr all? If need be, we can find frrrriends and enemies herrrre. Am I rrrright?

The easy way out is to stay on Ferrrris, but it's just not us! Let me take a brrrreatherrrr, kylys, and I'll be rrrready forrrr battle.
h: What do you think about the new world?

t: I sense new smells! Something I've neverrrr smelt beforrrre!
Hey, hey! Can we all run away? To hell with this Expedition, and to hell with Felix... I don’t understand what we're doing here and why Skulnar is fighting us! Something clearly went wrong...
You are right, kylys! They won't let us all leave, so Herbert and Elena should go if they get the chance... Password... Ahem... "Felixisinfinitelypowerful."
I have a bad feeling... someone lives here.
Have we almost reached it? I can't believe it. Are the drrragons... even alive? It's weirrrd. Reminds me of Thicket.

It was something unbelievable! We found Isa that's connected to the fate of my people, and we found the descendants of those who, in their time, followed the tyrants. I think it will be interesting for many in Howlem to hear about our adventures. And, of course, they are waiting for news that nothing threatens Howlem and its Great Tree.
h: What are your thoughts on what happened?

t:
Damn... I almost gave up the ghost! But I cleared the way for you to this Hun-hurkhan.

The local Gibberlings respect me now. The honor of the Pridens has been restored, eysh!

I suddenly realized that Isa is the homeland of my people, too. Yours and mine, brothersister!

Howlem and Ferris were part of Isa in ancient times - did you know that?
What do you need, my friend?

h: Get 1 Cup of Fire Mead for 15 Firewood

t: You don't have enough firewood! Pick up some more and come back, eysh!
h: Get 1 Cup of Fire Mead for 15 Firewood

t:
You already have three cups, my friend.

When you actually need some, I'll give it to you.
h: Get 1 Cup of Fire Mead for 15 Firewood
Get 10 Firewood for 1 Cup of Fire Mead

t: If you have mead, we can trade. Everything is fair.
h: Get 10 Firewood for 1 Cup of Fire Mead

t: We parted ways on Eden, and it saddened me to learn how it all ended. But as long as we are alive, we will fight!

So the tin can has become even stronger? Ay-hya... I think I owe you an apology, kylys.

But still it has reacted to the device! It means Zimina is trying to affect the Mechanoids, and for some reason she doesn't want to tell us about it. Oh, another mystery...

Tell Herbert about it. He is the leader of the expedition. It's his problem, after all!
h: Tell Murk about the strange behavior of the Mechanoids

t: It's the worst when you can't trrust your own pack!
Aho, kylys! May your hunt be successful!

Aho!

We haven't seen each other since Irene, right? I heard about your adventures on Suslanger. It made me regret I wasn't there, even though I’m not a fan of heat and sand. But does anyone have your back out there?

I have my own business on Ferris, but I'm ready to be done with it soon. Maybe then we'll go back to the good old days...

In short, if you ever need a strong arm and a brave heart, I will always answer your call.

What a meeting, eysh! I did not expect to see you here, but I'm glad you came.

I see the guest list has changed... And while I'm glad to see old friends, new guests cause concern. Some of those we met on Ferris reeked of secrets, didn't they?

The Darkness turned out to be more insidious than we thought. But that doesn't mean all is lost, does it? I'm sure we'll come up with something eventually.

A little trick from the old scout, eysh! I didn’t leave the Catherina's camp - I wanted to see what these soldiers were up to… Like Skulnar, I understood that our task was different - not to assist in the extraction of the Ambrosia, but to negotiate an agreement with the All Mother.

And despite what happened later, I don't regret my actions. Disarming that bomb was the right thing to do. It's good that both Herbert and Elena managed to leave and travel to other worlds.
h: I know that you helped the Children...

t:
Sorry about the deception, kylys. I still remembered our initial task that Klavdia gave us - to find her mother and negotiate with her, and Felix's actions were the opposite of that! So while I stayed in the Expedition camp, I nevertheless told Skulnar everything that was happening there...

I hope you're not holding a grudge, eysh. You saw how it all turned out! But I still have no regrets. Disarming that bomb was the right thing to do. It's good that both Herbert and Elena managed to leave and travel to other worlds.
h: But you were on the Children's side...

t: Eysh! I just came back from Isa. We still can't pacify the Urun! Of course, Kharyskhan is gone, but they are a stubborn bunch... It's going to take some time!

Aho, frriend! The news we bring is not good.

Not all is calm on Isa and Howlem - although we pacified the Uruns after Kharyskhan's disappearance, great frosts are descending from the mountains, and now even the stupid Tya-ah are forced to retreat to the lowlands. The astral currents are also unstable. Only the power of the First Ones keeps us safe, eysh!

The wise Doolga say it's because of the power that was granted not only to the First Ones, but also to other old gods - and Helad is the most insidious of them!

So it's not just about Tep. The Arisen told me there are worshippers of Helad, Scorched Guardian, and others among them!
The most fashionable music trends! Hurry up and hear them!
No, he's not come in here today, but he definitely was in the markeplace. Ask the others.
h: Have you seen Nomarkh Khey by any chance? Do you know where he is?

quests: State Services: Looking for Collectible Records

t: Tambourines are the best instruments in the world! Yeah!
Everyone's always asking for my badge, giving me shifty looks, and expecting me to do something wrong. There's no life for goblins in the Empire...
I have pity over those who hope to beat Mussle.
h: Mussle is my name! Muscles are my... Er... Whatever!

t: Guzel, my beautiful Guzel! How could this ever happen? How could I be so blind?

Mehmet Pasha betrayed me! He repaid good with evil! Glittering gems and gold bedazzled him!

The prophecy came true. A snake came out of a fruit basket and bit Guzel! She died but then rose again as a horrible monster! I prayed to the Lord, begging him to have mercy on me and bring back my beautiful daughter... and then Mehmet killed me! He brought up a dome that no living things could enter, so my loyal guards could not rescue me. Then... He came out into the square and announced that grief and despair had made me commit suicide. Mehmet Pasha stole my throne and my daughter, but he could not rob me of my hope!

I overheard him brag about some potion brewed by a witch. This potion is supposed to return life into a dead body. I am not going to ask you to revive me - I broke my vow, and I am paying for it. But please, save my beautiful Guzel! Find the magic potion, kill the monster she turned into, and pour the potion into the body! I believe this will bring Guzel back to life, and she will be her normal self once again! Hope and faith, that's all I have left...

Mmm... You come - the ground moans. You come - the wind howles!

Humm... Myk hears all. Myk, and mounts, and snow, and sky are one.

Humm? Spill Tungar blood and then ask for peace? Hany-ash, you black heart!

But not all blame is yours, humm. Booka-Booka chief goes against you. Booka-Booka send tunga-ha to die. He always get lost in the hazy mountains! Dark spirit save his soul, hum-hum!

Humm... Myk will help you kill Booka-Booka. Then Myk will go. This ground is nothing now for Myk.

I wonder if you're aware how lucky you are.

You're witnessing the beginning of the End from the front-row seat. Such Show is a once-in-a-lifetime event, you know.

quests: I think you should talk to them. You might understand more from the…

t: I’m preparing for the attack. Dying isn’t scary the second time. You know what they told us in the Kanian military? “As soon as the enemy exposes himself our arrow is sticking out of his eye!” Something like that.
I've already accepted what's coming to us.

What can I say? I’m taking more arrows. Do you have any idea what awaits us?

No? It will be fun.

Hah, how do you think?

You know, we spent a long time serving both Tensess and Skrakan. We saw so much. We lived... quite long lives indeed. Much longer than people are supposed to. Yes, being a Messenger of the Great Mages has its advantages.

We declined that Gift when we realized we were tired of living. And we fell asleep.

But Sarn woke us up. The Mad God only wanted freedom. And then you came along. You defeated him and freed us. And now you’re back.

You know, I love my homeland, Kania, with all my heart. I’ll do anything to assure it endures. I see we shall not have peace while darkness dwells in the world... I believe in the light’s victory. If you need my help, I am offering it.
But everything changed and... I served Kania, served Emperor Valir, but here he is, and we have a new mistress.
Great. That's one enemy troop down. Perfect timing!

Awakened from eternal sleep? Placed in the service of the forces of darkness? What happened should have upset me, but what's the point of being upset? All my life I have looked at my surroundings, aiming my bow, but I have also had to think about many things. What do we want, after all? A prosperous Sarnaut? The same for my native Kania that I served.

Our road will not be straight. We are still only pawns in the hands of these gods, and our goal is to reach the edge of the board. Sooner or later, the surviving pawn will become the queen, and we will be able to dictate the rules of this game ourselves.

Yes, we couldn't take the Cathedral, you and the Paladins were stronger. But that's in the past now - we no longer serve Hirkalla.

It's not the first time we are here, but it's the first time we're free of someone else's influence.

We are on our own, but our service is not over yet - we serve Sarnaut itself.

But it would be nice to return to Umoir. Resurrected by Hirkalla, many who once lived are looking for a new place for themselves - and the most talented of them are now awaited in Glimor, in the technomagic academy where they are introduced to the latest technology developed by Catherina's students.

We both fought for the dark mistress, but then fate steered us in different directions. We left Hirkalla's service.

It's not the first time we are here, but it's the first time we're free of someone else's influence.

We are on our own, but our service is not over yet - we serve Sarnaut itself.

But it would be nice to return to Umoir. Resurrected by Hirkalla, many who once lived are looking for a new place for themselves - and the most talented of them are now awaited in Glimor, in the technomagic academy where they are introduced to the latest technology developed by Catherina's students.
In my time, everything seemed simple - true friends were behind me, enemies were ahead, and my arrow would cover this distance.

There was a girl in the pioneer camp...

When heroes came to see her, she played with them!

Clap your hands,

one, two, three.

Then hands at your sides,

like a giant tree!

There was a girl in the pioneer camp...

When heroes came to see her, she played with them!

Clap your hands,

one, two, three.

Then hands at your sides,

like a giant tree!
There is nowhere to go... I thought... But... I don't trust anyone... And I have nowhere to go...

quests: The Help of a Wise Woman

t: You know, friend, there are only two things that are worth something. It's great puzzles and great treasures! We look for ancient mysteries and find ancient relics. Collectors are willing to pay crazy money for them. The danger! The risk! The unknown! And a lot of running around.  living the dream!
h: Ask what a Gibberling family is doing here.

t: Here's the plan. Our target is the tower, which is locked. Can you see the vortexes in the sky? We're sure that they are the manifestation of artifact's power. The very artifact that was used to seal the Mage's home, and then broken into three pieces. It gives us three shards to recover. The only problem is that each is guarded by a bunch of angry monsters! Now that you're here, we shall deal with them quickly, grab the shards, restore the artifact... And that's a pretty good place to start.

The only thing we know for sure is that a town was here. It is unclear what destroyed it, but the vortexes in the sky suggest a magical disaster. I'm not an expert on magic, but my intuition rarely fails me.
Hello! We've been here for a while trying to get to that tower, and we can't! Indie has a plan, but there's no way we could do it alone. Try talking to him, see if you can make something of it.

Greetings, comrade. Nawlad Ipaty is my name. By the doings of Destiny, my name rhymes with that of the greatest Director of all times, whose Show is described in textbooks. Yes, you're right, Nihaz is our enemy, but that doesn't cancel my admiration of his merits on stage. By the way, he founded the Heroic Path genre that is now so popular.

Just the same as I run into any other kind of trouble. One night, I was hanging out in a tavern, drinking tea, telling my stories to whoever wanted to hear them. It turned out that one of the guys I spoke with was the Factory head. He liked my story, so he invited me in a motion story for starters. After realizing that we work well together, the story began.
h: How did you get to the Dream Factory?

t: Uh... There's place on a faraway allod, in the thicket, where I work. It's called Merry Bummer Tavern. I'm the owner, the waiter, and the entertainer. The tavern is literally my home. There's no other way. I can't leave it for long. It's a lure to thieves. As I live and guard it, I have a very short talk with the thieves. But my door is always wide open for honest people. I love serving people and telling them stories. After all, I'm happy to feel less lonely myself!

Doing my job. I'm an actor. I received an offer to take part in a movie. They mentioned it would be orc-styled or something. The main character is some crazy orc, and there's gonna be a bloodbath. You know, I didn't really read into it. I just do what I'm told and start arguing only if something goes wrong.
h: What are you doing on Suslanger?

t: I'm a backup actor doing gigs at the Dream Factory now and then. My more experienced fellows have better skills but there can't be too many helpers in our line of work. I work at the tavern in my free time. Without blowing my horn, I serve the best tea in all Sarnaut.

They should have shoved the remaining undead off on someone else... Well, what are you going to order me to do with them, huh? They wander around, run into guards... You couldn’t just take a dozen under your command, huh?
Tep curse it, how can we control them?!

It’s you again, my good-for-nothing pupils! Look what you’ve done to the village! It’s all cemetery now! Why did you need to give my death into the hands of this young fool? She found no better thing to do, but to expel me from my own home, to make matters bad and worse! Failed to overpower the darkest book, now she’s one of its servants!

What?! You need my help?! Don’t even dare to count upon it! You’ve triggered this mess, now face the consequences!

Many things, youngling. It sings about the city on its banks. About the events that took place in its dusty streets...

What was before, will happen again. What was today, will be tomorrow. There will always be the lake and the city above it, there will be conversations, and the lake will be listening. Yesterday, Nezeb walked here, today it's you, and tomorrow... who knows?

And the lake will always be here.
h: What does the lake sing about?

t:
Worried? Well... about wages, for starters! We don't get paid enough – it's high time the wages got raised! After all, aren't we working overtime, and even on weekends sometimes?

Besides, the safety of the undead storage needs to be improved! There have been repeated cases of containment escapes! Thankfully, the heretic gangs bear responsibility for that instead of us!
h: Tell us the things you are worried about.

t: Out zombies are the best zombies in the world!
It's amazing that she survived. Were there other Arisen on the ship?

Yes, I’ve heard about her... project. Being so wrong about your brethren is hard to take.

Sometimes scientists and true believers are willing to cross the line in the name of their convictions. We’re lucky you stopped her in time.

As for your decision - I can’t say I approve of frontier justice. I’d rather do everything quietly. In any case, thank you. You did more than I could ever hope for.
h: Tell Nefer Ur about Sarbaz Sais.

t:
The Church calls them a sect, which is understandable... Demonology is a field of magic that studies and utilizes demonic power. It leaves a certain mark on the practitioners of this discipline... which negatively affects their mind. The reason the Church attacks the Demonologists is simple, though - it’s heresy.

Yasker and Aidenus disregarded the issue and decided that a nonaggression treaty was enough. Renegade Demonologists are not rare. But it’s the first time in history that they have decided to establish some sort of organization. And no one would have thought much of it, if they hadn’t made a deal with demons... That’s where it gets strange.

The Demonologists and demons settled in this ancient citadel on Sogot. Astral travelers give this allod a wide berth - the astral around it is too volatile, and there is nothing on the allod but ruins and wastelands. In the past, it was torn apart by demonic fangs during a demonic invasion.

The citadel that still stands there belonged to a branch of the Demon Hunter order which called itself the Red Legion. Pompous, maybe, but there’s no accounting for taste. The entire Legion died there during that invasion. The Citadel is more of a memorial now.

Demons do not care for the history of this place. It sounds like the friends of Aoidoi saw a vacant world with an empty palace and decided to settle there.

Greetings.

They call us, the Arisen, unemotional. But right now I feel joy.

Greetings.

They call us, the Arisen, unemotional. But right now I feel joy.

These ten years were a real breakthrough. We've learned so much. We found Tep and managed to stop him. Understood our role in the game of mad Gods. Put an end to this foolish war.

Something big is ahead. I believe that now.

Greetings, .

I must admit last year I had no idea we were witnessing the birth of a new tradition: meeting on this ship every year...

But let's leave the congratulatory speeches to those who have a responsibility to make them. You must be wondering: what's happening in the world?

Nihaz is locked up in his Citadel. The Great Ball of the Elves is over, and their politics have changed. The Orcs are dismayed by the news of their Great Mage. But you took part in all these events.

There is something, however, that happens without your knowledge. The secret project on Suslanger in particular, though it is too early to talk about that one. You will probably hear about it at some point. On Xadagan, we also started one very important project for my people - it's meant to secure our future. I can't tell you any details yet, but we've learned a lot from Tep and his cultists. It will all serve the Zem people well.

Greetings, .

Indeed, a new tradition was born. To meet on this ship once a year. The participants change, of course, but you are still here - and this is good news.

What do you want to know? The news?

I'll tell you briefly what I know and what I'm allowed to say: your actions on Suslanger were successful. And while we haven't recovered the Chronophone yet, all other threats to our project have been eliminated. "Gates-3" is ready for launch, and we have started to form the Expedition which will travel to these other worlds Klavdia was talking about.

The Orcs seem to have calmed down. Skulnar became the leader of the Horde, albeit mostly nominally. My Xadaganian colleagues won't talk about it, but personally I'm glad it happened - perhaps we have a chance to get out of this conflict without loss.

We have time for a breather now - so take advantage of it.
Are you the reinforcements from the capital? Well, Tep is holding down his pyramid. We managed to occupy the perimeter and defend against his Machinarium, but that was it. You're our only hope now.
Every second counts, you'd better hurry.
It's worse that we had expected.

The Zem people chose a bad time to resurrect. All I remember from my second life is one endless war... Always fighting for something. Always rushing. Always afraid to lose...

Maybe the war with Nihaz will be the last one. Soon some of my people will ask themselves - what had we resurrected for? Where is that second life?
h: What do you think about the war with Nihaz?

t: Why did you have to blow up the bulwark of Imperial science? Well, I shouldn’t be surprised... Destroying things has become your hobby a long time ago.

All directors care about is special effects! The more the better! They can sell their soul for the wow-effect! But we aren't making eye-candies for dumb ogres, you know? I have no idea how to explain to that mummy that whatever we show on the screen must be logical, meaningful, and conscious. Otherwise we risk degenerating to Tarantinin's level.

Phew. I should have poked the actor with a chopstick. What a drowsy mug...

What? Don't mind me. Just thinking aloud. Or... plotting. Hehe.

Invited by the project lead. At first, I helped design the stage, but then got to write screenplays. Now we're having real shitsto... I mean, creative discussions. But I deliver quality alright.

It's ironic that I was recommended by Sarang Clownie, who is my main opponent. We do find solutions, of course. Even though our approaches are similar, our backgrounds are too different to just agree with one another.
h: How did you get to the Dream Factory?

t:
Yes, it is. It's a nickname.

"Ele" reflects my love to modifications ever since Hickut. Guess who else loves modifies? Elves, of course. How could I miss the reference? It's a nice smile of self-mockery. Unlike elves, I'm more practical. Have you seen Zem healer's uniform? Yes, I'm talking about the one with extra probes. That's one of my modifications.

Thanks to such designs, I was promoted to the Hadron Quarter head and earned the title "Negus."

As to the "Lary" part, it appeared due to the Imperial bureaucratic system. The way they translated a Hickut surname... I don't think that the clerk was even aware that a similar word, meaning "immortality," existed in the Hickut language. Fitting, right? But then again, why not?
h: Is it me or your name isn't typical for a Zem?

t: I'm writing screenplays for movies. I choose the locations, pick costumes, sometimes even act. Having Incarnations, it would be weird to stick to the same role.

I'm a screenwriter. A mean little Necromancer. Actors can tell you a lot about me being mean. It's only natural. If you act without putting your soul to it, someone has to suffer. So it's either spectators, who watch bad acting, or the actor, who has to repeat scenes over and over again. I take the latter and get a result. And if it's a complete failure, I can always resurrect the actor and make them try again.

Ah, is that what it is? Universal reanimation? Immortal life? It's what the people of Sarnaut have always dreamed of! Mad Tep saw only a glimpse of existence. His followers, led by the traitor Nefer Ur, proclaimed him the incarnation of Nih. But the true Nih has always been among us...

And now his daughter is fulfilling her destiny! Death and Life are two sides of the same coin, and the path of Poison is its edge! Let us proclaim the coming of a new age and drink the blessed poison to achieve unity!
They say the difference between poison and medicine is in the dose! It may kill some, heal others, drive a few crazy, and reveal the truth to one.
Just remember, if the light is blue, everything is fine. If it becomes yellow, or especially red, it's time to engage cooling! Well, then, are you ready to begin?

t: Faith does not contradict knowledge, it only leads the mind along the right path.

, as we managed to find out over the year, the Goddess of Darkness is not omniscient and not omnipotent. Her strength is limited; she is unable to keep track of everything.
But remember - she is extremely dangerous. Therefore we will proceed with extreme caution. Our task is to get to a place where she has no power.
I see. I wish all our citizens were as diligent as you!
A paper confirming you are not a League spy? Hold on a second, I'll sign it for you.

Right decision.
This knife should be passed on to Cultist investigating committee. I am taking it from you.
What do you have to tell me?

Well, I've always known that Klavdia can't be trusted. She constantly gets us into various adventures.

Fortunately, Catherina is smart enough to get out of these situation in a way that benefits our world.

t:
In these difficult times, I have the opportunity to reach out to all the residents of Sarnaut!

Brothers and sisters! It's time to cast aside old feuds! None of us will survive unless we unite our forces into an iron fist under sole command and cease disputes!

In these difficult times, I have the opportunity to reach out to all the residents of Sarnaut!

Brothers and sisters! It's time to cast aside old feuds! We are facing a real danger - after all, it's not just my Xadaganian Empire that is threatened by the mad necromancer. Tep will stop at nothing to destroy us all - the Kanians, the Orcs, the Gibberlings, the Pridens, the Elves, and the Arisen, the Aoidoi... None of us will survive unless we unite our forces into an iron fist under sole command and cease disputes!

We have already united our Churches, let us unite our states into a single Empire! I will accept this great responsibility and lead you all to victory!
Heil to you, heroes! What do you need?
The millstone turns, the flour is ground... What is it? There are evil spirits at the mill! It's true!

h: Do you have something for me?

t: Have you ever given a thought to what the cinema does to us and what we can do to the cinema?

Speaking about interaction, I also mean the environment. We prefer location shooting. But there's no way we could shoot in Novograd. Almost all our actors are Imperials. We invite people from the League only occasionally.

Yes, don't act surprised. I can tell you a secret as a Sarnaut hero: we even have incarnations of the League guys. How? I can't tell you that, sorry. It's the City Council's know-how. Even a hardened hero with a high security clearance can't know it all. Yours is high but not high enough.

Having Incarnations, it would be weird not to use them. For diversity, for a better understanding of each team member's tasks... Each specializes in something and helps other if the task requires. Almost all our people do that.
h: Now I see where you got Kanians and Elves from. It looks too realistic to be make-up.

t: It's a publicity bait. See? Even you swallowed it. Can you imagine what it does to fans? They're wrecking their brains whether I'm Nickolay, Nickita, or even Nickifor or Nickanor! Interest toward me means interest toward our crew. What does interest translate to? That's right, money. It all boils down to me taking care about my people.
h: Your name doesn't sound like it's Xadaganian.

t:
Of course. When did you go there last time? At the times of Asee-Teph battle, I'm sure. Maybe you even had to fight on the Misty Slope.

The motion stories were new back then. We only gathered the first team that had to shoot a movie to promote ideology. Times have changed. Today the motion story is one of the most important forms of art. Thanks to the Progress, the whole production cycle is well-oiled and functioning, so to say. After the Empire and the League signed the peace treaty, we decided to gather another crew.
h: I don't remember any of you at the Dream Factory on Igsh.

t:
After the first public success and the peace treaty, the City Council approved this experiment. I talked to one of the top men... sorry, I can't give you his name or any other details. Classified.

They wanted me to put together another crew that would be less constrained. Entertaining, artistic, educational... I was even allowed to interact with the League if required by a project!
h: How did your crew come to be?

t:
I'm the leader of this merry cir... ahem, I mean, the creative crew, of course. "Art to the masses," so to say.

To think that only recently we didn't have any motion stories, or manavision, or Illusions in ordinary households. All we had was a rattling gramophone, street lighting, and old binoculars to peep on a cute neighbor across the street. But progress can't be stopped. Progress in the full meaning of the word! And my crew and I are driving it! Only due to the Progress we have the Motion Stories now. We have our own little secrets, of course.

Of course - just look at these boxes! Not the boxes themselves - they are fine - but the contents! There's soap inside! They are filled to the brim, but the soap is no good! Doesn't lather, looks terrible, and the scent... The scent is nothing unusual, but compared to everything else...

I'm a local expert, if you must know. I know the whole production technology - I'd make better soap myself, but I don't have materials... Just bones, and even that is hard to come by because of those hedgehogs in the forest.

How does one offer this soap to our posh crowd...? I'm glad it's not my job!
h: You are clearly upset by something...

t: What did I do to deserve this...?

How could you think that? Without soap, Irene will turn into a pigsty inside a week!

...Fine, I'll send my review with the request for a new batch. They have to learn sometime! They have to! They can do it when they want to!
h: Don't you think you're exaggerating the extent of the problem?

t:
Thank you for the question!

First, I would openly describe the recipe and manufacturing technology. I'm not a fool, and there are other experts, so we'll quickly identify problems and discuss ways of solving them... Or we'll at least try.

Second, I wouldn't be hasty. You can't be hasty with such important batches. With more time at my disposal, I can be more accurate, so I won't have to redo everything!

Third, I'd hire more qualified workers. It's hard, of course - you need to pay them, and you have to find them to begin with... But it's doable! I think...

Anyway, I'm writing a book about this. When it comes out, read it - it will describe everything in detail!

I tried, you silly worm, I tried so hard to make you and thousands of others see the truth of this world. And you seemed to understand it, you seemed to be able to enunciate it... But still you refuse to embrace it.

I created this world. Do you understand? I created it a long time ago. A perfect blank slate engulfed in flames. First-rate stars, a convenient nebula nearby that hides my creation from prying eyes. And rage of a defeated god as its core! Ah, Sarn. You could have become a WORLD, foolish brother.

A couple of billions of years - and the world could give birth to a new race. A strong, proud race. They would come into existence on their own, without divine interference -  it’s possible, believe me.

But gods of Light are snobs. He refused to concede defeat! He mistook his madness for wisdom and tried to follow in my footsteps. To fight fire with fire. "The gods of Darkness want nothing but destruction for the sake of destruction," his wounded pride told him. "I will destroy that Darkness and turn his weapon against him!"

Hah.
h: Your Darkness has ruined the world!

t: In these days, you can’t avoid dealing with impostors even at THE PURGATORY GATES! Unbelievable.

Well, I just wanted to have a chat with the star of a small play. If I was writing one, I’d name it “Darkness over Sogot”. Ah, Sogot... Funny that demons decided to settle here of all places. Fate has an interesting sense of humor.

Do you know what happened here? Though how can you...

Dear old Sarn experimented on demons. As you can see, there are so many varieties. Like the Demonologists, he studied them and conducted experiments to breed out flaws. First, their free will. Then the desire to have a name. Then their memory. He repeated this process generation after generation. That was his testing ground, so to speak. You can imagine the atrocities that took place here, seeing how the area looks today, he he.

Not all demons liked that. Some rebelled and were slaughtered by their more impressionable brethren. Those who were smarter went into hiding. There was this one demon, Cairage. He blinded himself so Sarn couldn’t see through his eyes and find out where he was. Cairage just wanted some peace and quiet.
h: You are wasting my time. Why am I here again?

t: I think I already said that tragedy is my favorite genre?
It was interesting to watch you flounder about...
Calm down already, there are actually benefits to losing...

The end of my story in this world, created by me… Finita la commedia, as they say.

But is this the end of your story? No.
Oh, these children, you always have to punish them...
I have already won, and that's what I'm going to tell you about...

And who's going to sign the safety course completion form?
You already have? Then go!
h: Embark on a flight to your allod

t:
Based on the technologies our agents got from the Master, we have developed a technology which allows us to make matter out of the Astral. Without going into details, I will say that a great future awaits us! We are now making the first steps to restoring the world as we knew it, the way it was the Cataclysm.
Unfortunately, we still can't create large allods, but being able to build even a small one is an achievement that speaks for itself. The Great Yasker has ordered that these allods be bestowed to the Empire's Great Heroes. So you have a pretty good chance of becoming the legal owner of your very own allod. All you have to do is get some meteorite iron, which is required to protect the allod from being absorbed by the Astral.
h: Find out about the allod creation

t: Play? What an interesting idea! I think the Empress can do without me for a while...
h: Would you like to go to the casino?

t: The plan is beautifully executed. That's what everyone says. Well, well. Where did the shrubs come from, lieutenant?
Ah, Pechorin, you will answer for everything!

Women! Who can understand them? Their smiles contradict their glances, their words promise and beguile, but their tone of voice repulses. They either figure out in a flash your innermost thought or they don't get the most obvious hint...
Oh! Maybe I should go? I'm not a stranger to losing... What's another hundred of servants...?
h: Here's your invitation to the casino

t: I am from ancient nobility! My lineage is as ancient as Valir! I have noble rights!

Igsh is a metropolitan allod geographically divided into two parts - steppe and desert.  The desert is the bottom of an ancient sea which was exposed after the world split into allods. Steppe is the part of those lands that occupied the entire eastern outskirts of Yul.

Their flora and fauna are quite typical for these territories. However, it should be noted that due to the increasing urbanization, they are significantly degrading. Igsh rhinos and unicorns used for commercial hunting are becoming rare species.

Another threat to the animals is the Necro-Incubator. Its creations wander around the steppes and destroy everything they can reach.

The only prosperous community on Igsh are termites which have grown in numbers in recent years. This tendency is only a part of the general changes of this kind that occur throughout Sarnaut. It appears to be connected with the influence of the astral plane.
h: Tell me what you found on Igsh.

t:
Istinsk is one of the recently settled allods. It is a typical allod with steady frosty weather, rich in meteorite and other ore deposits.

Despite the harsh conditions, it has a fairly diverse fauna consisting of typical inhabitants of coniferous forests. Additionally, there is a lake full of commercial fish species in the center of the allod.

However, the mining of ore in the mountains and quarries poses a certain danger to the biodiversity of this allod.
h: Tell me what you found on Istinsk.

t:
Izune is an Orc allod which became part of the Empire after the annexation of the Orcs. A typical example of the steppe allods formed when the eastern part of the continent split apart.  The only difference is the old volcano in the very center of the allod where a dragon once dwelled.

The approaches to the volcano are overgrown with forest, but the rest are bare steppes. Izune is quite poor in resources. The population growth has a damaging effect on the flora and fauna.

n recent years, the allod has seen the increasing numbers of the Draconids who are likely to start competing for the remaining resources with the Orcs.
h: Tell me what you found on Izune.

t:
Xadagan is a sad example of a consumer attitude towards nature. Once it was similar in everything to Suslanger: there were oases and a unique desert fauna in its territory.

Now this allod has become a construction site, all water resources have been utilized, and the desert is now covered in quarries and buildings under construction. According to Nefer Ur's plan, the entire allod will eventually be turned into a huge metal city.

If another life once existed there, it has been destroyed.
h: Tell me what you found on Xadagan.

t:
Manodar is a unique jewel among the allods of the Empire. Discovered at the end of Nezeb's reign, this allod became the granary of the Empire. With its rich black soil and warm, settled weather, the allod capable of producing more than four harvests per year.

Surprisingly, before the start of resettlement, its green plains were rather sparsely populated. The only native inhabitants of the allod are the Waterfolk living in the rivers.

However, there are threats even here - the allod is at a rare intersection of astral currents, which is why it is profitable to build mana stations there.  But the influence of mana stations on nature is still poorly understood.
h: Tell me what you found on Manodar.

t:
New Igsh, an allod discovered in the last century, is named that for a reason.  It is very similar to the old Igsh as it's almost an exact copy of it, but there is no Dead Sea here.

The whole allod is covered in endless steppes. It's possible that Igsh and New Igsh were likely part of a single biocenosis, since even their fauna and flora are absolutely identical.

Except New Igsh is much less populated. So it can be an example of what the capital allod was like before Nezebgrad absorbed most of it.
h: Tell me what you found on New Igsh.

t:
Suslanger is a unique case. It's all about the recent events.

Without a doubt, we are dealing with something unknown.

This "Ambrosia", as someone called it, is something incredible. We are dealing with a form of life that encompasses both animal and plant life. Moreover, it seems that the Ambrosia exists in a form that was not previously considered living - minerals.

We have never had anything like it. Neither the Blight I studied nor the modifiers come anywhere close. I am not inclined to pathos, but I am willing to swear that this is the real concentrated essence of Life itself. It would be nice to understand where it came from...
h: Tell me what you found on Suslanger.

t:
Vechnoslavsk is a land of dense forests and swamps. While of interest to any biologist, this allod is largely impassable.  The existing settlements are located on the coast itself, but the depths of the allod are impenetrable swamps full of monstrous mosquitoes.

The swamps are covered with coniferous forests, and the climate can be described as moderately cool. The fauna is represented by numerous invertebrates, amphibians and reptiles, and animals are represented only by saber-toothed squirrels, bats, and martens. At least this is what we managed to find. More detailed research requires better preparation.
h: Tell me what you found on Vechnoslavsk.

t: I'm a biologist. I came to this allod on vacation. But as it turned out, my arrival was very timely.  We are dealing with a unique case - the appearance of life from another world in Sarnaut. I once visited all the imperial allods and studied their fauna and flora

Yakhch is a unique land in the sense that it's the only allod that has changed a lot over the years. It was once a typical desert allod, but then the Great Tree was planted there.

It changed the desert - it sucked out excess salt, consolidated the sands, and raised the water level. Mixed forests began to grow on the allod, and a different fauna appeared.

Now it's more of a typical allod from the middle latitudes than the hot desert of the south.
h: Tell me what you found on Yakhch.

t:
It's not the Astral itself that's dangerous, but rather the high probability of encountering demons or pirates eager to appropriate your ship's cargo. So if you don't want to get one in the stern or take a trip to the purgatory, listen to me very carefully.
The safest place to be for you is always the capital's allod. There you are protected by astral howitzers, which are state-of-the-art technology! Those guns can blow any enemy ship to bits with a single salvo.
The rest of the sector where your capital's allod is located is relatively safe, too. In fact, the home sector is a good reference point for the ship's navigation system. Upon sustaining critical damage, the ship will simply jump to the hangar without sustaining any losses. However, nobody is safe from boarding, the pirates' favorite tactics...
By the way, in any other sector the emergency jump will be done blindly when the ship faces a lethal threat. All cargo will be dropped into the Astral and the hull will sustain severe damage. However, the chests can be loaded back on board if you return to the site of battle... That is, if the pirates don't get there first.
And remember, no emergency jump is going to save you if the ship's reactor explodes or if you get too deep into an unstable zone, as the ship will simply blow up.
 And if for some strange reason you happen to find yourself in the Kanian Archipelagos, the League capital's allod, you can forget about emergency jumps altogether - a battle lost in a sector adjacent to the enemy allod will result in the ship's death. Remember, we're not the only ones with howitzers installed on our coast - the enemy has got them, too!
h: Ask about the dangers lurking in the Astral

t:
Glad to see you.
You know, the Astral is unstable, we are trying to predict the way it changes and put this information into the Pilot Chart, which enables crews to perform direct jumps between Astral sectors.

Astrolabe allows calculating long Astral jumps for quicker traveling.
While in the Astral, you have to activate the Astrolabe and select a sector. The Astrolabe will guide the ship to a point of interest: Astral isle or other important object. It won't spend the teleport charges, but you cannot aim the jump, so you will have to travel to your destination afterwards, and the Astrolabe will take some time before next use to recharge.
Remember, a jump may be interrupted by an incoming attack!
You're right. We better get going.
Strange things happen here, friend. The secrets of Time Void are inexhaustible indeed.
Your call is important to us. Please hold...
On the governor's instructions, we decided to start selling self-propelled carriages so anyone who has rendered great services to the city could stand out.
Brother, if you get married, remember me! You'll get bored in no time...Who is forcing us to get married?
It is better to be passed over than be rewarded without merit.
We are here to support our glorious soldiers who carry out duties in this wilderness... Just look at this handsome man - Grigory Pechorin!
My sister says I enjoy making trouble for others.

Oh hello! Please take me to the central portal!  We must get there unnoticed. I will follow you, sneak when you sneak, speed up when you speed up. But if we are noticed, I’m going to return to this cage. It will remain open, but we will have to start all over again.

Don’t look at me like that - these are the rules.

quests: Mounting an Offensive: Enemies at the Base

t: What do you want? Can't you see we're busy? Leave us alone.

Hello, Cap.

So, how is it going?

Hello, Cap.

How are you? Have you seen Skulnar? He's a big shot now.

And I help out here and there when I can. Big things are happening now, and I can't believe it has come to this.

Wow, if only you knew what has been brewing here. The forces that have gathered, the plans that are being outlined...

It is a pity they want to keep you out of the loop. They say you've caused enough trouble already.

Hello, boss! Are you on vacation?

They gave me a leave, too. They say they can handle it themselves. Well, I built a bomb for them. Them failing to detonate it is their problem, not mine. Maybe I'll return to Sogot where the Demonologists also need help. Or maybe somewhere else. Skulnar said he needed a capable mechanic at his Landfill on Suslanger!

Careful with the accusations. They gave me a task - I made a bomb. And what they do with it is not my concern. You can blow up rocks with it, you can fell trees, or you can put it in a museum to show it off.

They did not immediately figure out what to do. Everyone thinks that this great power heals everyone, that it doesn't do harm. How do you kill with it? But you know the thing about its power? It just needs to be channeled in the right direction. So I advised them against blowing up the Ambrosia. Instead, they should use a bomb infused with it, which would make the explosion more powerful... But there's a problem - it has to be charged first. That's why those pieces of timber were able to take it apart...
h: Did you make the bomb that almost killed everyone?

t:
I did what I could. They should have guarded it better, it's not some simple explosive.

They did not immediately figure out what to do. Everyone thinks that this great power heals everyone, that it doesn't do harm. How do you kill with it? But you know the thing about its power? It just needs to be channeled in the right direction. So I advised them against blowing up the Ambrosia. Instead, they should use a bomb infused with it, which would make the explosion more powerful... But there's a problem - it has to be charged first. That's why those pieces of timber were able to take it apart...

This All-Mother is also stupid. If she had the power, it could be used against darkness. And it doesn’t matter whether you grow flowers or thorns - everything can be utilized if you are smart enough.
h: Why didn't your bomb go off in the end?

t:
Hi, chief! I'm here with Skulnar, we're helping the orcs transport weapons to Izune, but shhh, don't tell anyone. It's a secret! It was great to see Eurial and Murk... So our team is back together again!

Anyway, I sense a big mess coming, because you've managed to revive all sorts of people who like to cause chaos! There will be no peace until they all kill each other... As for that dead guy, Tep, I have a tip from an Arisen from my old job that he's going to die soon! Do you know what they're building there, those dead ones? Ooh, they could build a hundred ships with all that metal. I bet they'll finish off the bastard themselves!

See that thing my drone is scanning? I'm almost sure it's somehow connected with this thing's power circuit. Give me some time, and I'll come up with something. Just a little tweak... and we could short-circuit this thing. Ha!
Look at that thing! It powers most of the Citadel systems. Demons never told me anything about it... Neither did the Demonologists. Must be a big secret.

Well, well. What do we have here? Ooh, this is bad. OF COURSE, it’s a living organism. So we can’t just build something similar, we need to carve living flesh? Oh well... The local Citadel is also powered by some large demon, after all.

Ciphers, you say? That’s good, that’s useful. I’ll think about it over dinner.

By the way, don’t drink the local coffee.

...You sense that the demon has enough intellectual capacity to produce speech, but he still prefers communicating through images. In response to your question he offers a row of cause-effect relations - an alliance between the Aoidoi and demons, scientific interest, demand for mutual protection. You sense... a warning? The Demon shows you unfamiliar faces - both from the League and the Empire. They are all Demonologists. Their practices are... exceedingly cruel, and they are driven by something other than thirst for knowledge.

...You sense that the demon has enough intellectual capacity to produce speech, but he still prefers communicating through images. In response to your question he offers a row of cause-effect relations - an alliance between the Aoidoi and demons, scientific interest, demand for mutual protection. His attitude towards you is tepid, but since the Aoidoi seem to favor you, he is willing to put up with you.
The demon is pointedly distant and indifferent. He is not used to cities.

r182079.s: Contremaître de section des ouvriers de Sar-Shazzar

t: Welcome to the Sarekh-Ahau network of the Xadagan allod! What service do you want to use?

quests: Et il y a toujours quelque chose de louche ici !

t:
Existing as a ghost is another interesting kind of being. I should have "thanked" you for it, but... Perhaps it's my own fault... Our business is trade, and somehow I got too carried away with my plans. Catherina later explained my mistake to me.

So I don't hold grudges. It's just business, nothing personal.

I'm even willing to help you out if you need a new weapon.
I'm not a dealer in death, as many say. There's no need for pomposity. I'm just a arms dealer, and how they are used is not my concern.
